prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: chess game UI sprite
Style reference: Image 1: edit target.
Primary request: Make the entire coloured sprite very faint and genuinely SEE-THROUGH. Reduce ALPHA of ALL coloured pixels to 35% opacity; preserve their RGB colours. This is a subtle overlay sprite, not opaque metal. Keep every other shape, pixel cluster and location unchanged.
Materials & palette: original colours retained, no added ornaments, discrete pixel shades only.
Composition/framing: one centred complete asset, transparent exterior and original openings.
Pixel treatment: PIXEL ART, hard stepped square clusters, nearest-neighbour; no smooth shading.
Output: genuine transparent RGBA PNG, actual low-alpha translucent foreground and alpha-zero exterior. Do NOT simulate transparency with a checkerboard or solid dark fill.
Constraints: no text; no antialiasing; no smooth gradients; no 3D render; no exterior glow or shadow; no checkerboard; no watermark; one asset only.
reason: Withheld: low-opacity request was not followed reliably; filled tiles retained smooth shading. No postprocessing permitted.
